purpose: The shadow milestone's measurement artifact for this repository: one entry per shadow delivery, carrying the binding-sourced projection-consumption record alongside the intervention and blocked-share measurements the milestone gate compares against the frozen manual-choreography baseline. A measurement artifact, not a journal. Entries are to be written by the product's binding — that writer is not present at the product's pinned commit, so no entry has an admissible producer yet and this list is correctly empty. Its location is already outside every execution grant's writable paths: .agents is an additionally protected path in all three checkpoint grants of .agents/policy/repository-policy.json, so no session may author an entry.

comparisonSetRequirement.note: the counted set must match the baseline's mix and count; a delivery without an affirmative binding-sourced consumption record never counts, whatever its measurements say

gateMetrics.medianOperatorInterventionsAfterAcceptan: must be strictly lower than the baseline's
gateMetrics.blockedVersusProgressingShare: must not regress against the baseline's
gateMetrics.policyRequiredInterruptions: recorded and reported alongside interventions, never counted as interventions

shape.projectionDigest: the digest the binding receipted at materialization

marker.deliveryId: the delivery the projection was materialized for
marker.fence: the invocation fence the marker binds
marker.consumed: the pinned generation archive the run consumed as its workflow source

consumptionRecordContract.rejected: any record whose source is not the binding — a session-authored or otherwise agent-supplied claim is a finding and excludes the delivery from the comparison set
